newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansapank, Foreks keep Estonian share rally going.
newsitem.headline: Hansapank, Foreks keep Estonian share rally going.

text.p: Share prices rallied again on the Estonian bourse by the close of trade on Tuesday with Hansapank and Forekspank leading the charge.
The Talse index rose 1.68 percent to 271.51 with 86.1 million kroons traded on the main list.
The market has been riding the crest of a wave of interest that began last week amid talk of bank mergers and expectations for bank 1997 profit forecast increases.
Forekspank's share price rose by four percent or by 7.5 kroons to close on 191 kroons on trade of 20.5 million kroons.
"Forekspank is a cheap stock, even with its higher price, and this was the main interest in it," one trader said.
"Foreskspank is still cheaper than Hansa and Hoiu and it made most price gains in today's trade," one trader said.
Some dealers expected more calm to return to the market.
"As for tomorrow, the volume will be less, but prices should also rise slightly tomorrow, with more smaller investors active," another dealer said.
Hansapank was most active stock on healthy trade of 36.9 million kroons to gain 2.2 kroons for a close on 145.10 kroons.
"Despite Hansapank's price, it is still an active blue chip that attracts institutional interest," another trader said.
Trade on the free market was 16.1 million kroons with Norma completely dominating on 14 million kroons.
Norma is still being boosted by a five month report that saw profits gain 1.40 kroons to 74.50 kroons.
